metas.name: Shoplifters
metas.description:
Captures a household that is a family and a crime at once. A poor Tokyo family who shoplift to get by take in a neglected little girl; shared croquettes and a beach day sit alongside the question of what they actually are to each other.

On the margins of Tokyo, a dysfunctional band of outsiders are united by loyalty, a penchant for petty theft and playful grifting. When the young son is arrested, secrets are exposed that upend their tenuous, below-the-radar exist...

metas.name: La Haine
metas.description:
Captures a day with nowhere for the anger to go. Black-and-white, 24 hours in a Paris banlieue after a riot: three friends, one lost police revolver, a lot of waiting and joking, under its recurring falling-man line — 'so far, so good.'

24 hours in the lives of three young men in the French suburbs the day after a violent riot.

metas.name: City of God
metas.description:
Captures violence as a career ladder for children. A Rio favela across two decades, narrated by a kid who wants out via a camera while his peers climb by killing.

In the slums of Rio, two kids' paths diverge as one struggles to become a photographer and the other a kingpin.

metas.name: A Prophet
metas.description:
Captures an education in power. A young illiterate man enters a French prison with nothing and learns languages, networks, violence and patience, scene by scene, until the hierarchy is his.

A delinquent Muslim man struggles to get by in prison until he is taken under the wing of a powerful mob boss, but his gradual rise through the organization's ranks brings him in conflict with his mentor.

metas.name: Memories of Murder
metas.description:
Captures investigators failing, for real. South Korea's first serial murder case, 1986: local cops who beat confessions out of people, a Seoul detective who trusts evidence, and a country equipped for neither to work.

In a small Korean province in 1986, two detectives struggle with the case of multiple young women being found raped and murdered by an unknown culprit.

metas.name: Uncut Gems
metas.description:
Captures gambling mania as perpetual motion. A New York jeweller owes everyone and keeps placing the next bet to fix the last one; the film never lets him or you breathe for two hours.

With his debts mounting and angry collectors closing in, a fast-talking New York City jeweler risks everything in hope of staying afloat and alive.

metas.name: The Act of Killing
metas.description:
Captures impunity as performance. Indonesian mass killers, never punished and locally celebrated, gleefully re-stage their killings as Hollywood genres, until one man's body reacts before his conscience does.

A documentary which challenges former Indonesian death-squad leaders to reenact their mass-killings in whichever cinematic genres they wish, including classic Hollywood crime scenarios and lavish musical numbers.

metas.name: Perfect Blue
metas.description:
Captures fame eating a person's grip on which self is hers. A pop idol turned actress, a stalker, and a fan site narrating her life in first person — the animated form is what makes the slippage work.

A pop singer gives up her career to become an actress, but she slowly goes insane when she starts being stalked by an obsessed fan and what seems to be a ghost of her past.

metas.name: Heat
metas.description:
Captures professionalism as a whole identity, on both sides of the law. A robber and a detective each incapable of a life outside the work, recognising themselves in each other over coffee.

A group of high-end professional thieves start to feel the heat from the LAPD when they unknowingly leave a verbal clue at their latest heist.

metas.name: No Country for Old Men
metas.description:
Captures an older moral world realising it no longer applies. A man finds drug money, a killer flips coins, and a sheriff narrates his own obsolescence; it goes quiet exactly where other thrillers go loud.

Violence and mayhem ensue after a hunter stumbles upon the aftermath of a drug deal gone wrong and over two million dollars in cash near the Rio Grande.

metas.name: Cure
metas.description:
Captures emptiness spreading from person to person. A Tokyo detective investigates murders where each killer is different, calm, and cannot explain themselves — hypnotic and grey rather than jumpy.

A frustrated detective deals with the case of several gruesome murders committed by people who have no recollection of what they've done.

metas.name: A Brighter Summer Day
metas.description:
Captures adolescence inside a whole society holding its breath. Taipei, 1960 — exiled mainland families, street gangs, Elvis, a famous murder case — four hours that build a world rather than a plot.

Based on a true story, primarily on a conflict between two youth gangs, a 14-year-old boy's girlfriend conflicts with the head of one gang for an unclear reason, until finally the conflict comes to a violent climax.

metas.name: Chungking Express
metas.description:
Captures city loneliness at pop speed. Hong Kong, two lovesick cops, expired pineapple cans, and a snack-bar girl breaking into a man's flat to clean it while 'California Dreamin'' loops.

Two melancholic Hong Kong policemen fall in love: one with a mysterious female underworld figure, the other with a beautiful and ethereal waitress at a late-night restaurant he frequents.

metas.name: Le Samouraï
metas.description:
Captures cool as ritual and solitude. A Paris hitman in a trench coat, a grey room, a bird in a cage, an alibi arranged like furniture — almost no psychology given, all behaviour.

After professional hitman Jef Costello is seen by witnesses, his efforts to provide himself an alibi drive him further into a corner.

metas.name: Thief
metas.description:
Captures a craftsman trying to buy a normal life with one last job. A Chicago safecracker with a collage of his dream life in his wallet, neon and rain, tools on metal filmed like jewellery-making.

After years in prison, ace safe-cracker Frank owns a car dealership and a cocktail lounge, which are fronts for high-stakes jewelry heists. He wants to complete one last big heist for the Mob before he goes straight.

metas.name: Dog Day Afternoon
metas.description:
Captures a bank robbery becoming a live street spectacle. One hot Brooklyn afternoon, Pacino working the crowd outside like a rally, and the reason for the robbery arriving piece by piece.

Three amateur robbers plan to hold up a Brooklyn bank. A nice, simple robbery: Walk in, take the money, and run. Unfortunately, the supposedly uncomplicated heist suddenly becomes a bizarre nightmare as everything that could go wr...

metas.name: The Assassination of Jesse James by the Coward Robert Ford
metas.description:
Captures celebrity worship in 1882. A famous outlaw ageing and paranoid, and a young admirer who memorised his life from dime novels and moves into his orbit — slow, golden, narrated like a history book.

Robert Ford, who has idolized Jesse James since childhood, tries hard to join the resurgent gang of the Missouri outlaw, but gradually becomes resentful of the bandit leader.

metas.name: Thelma & Louise
metas.description:
Captures escape becoming irreversible, and friendship becoming absolute. A weekend trip, a parking lot, a gun — then two women driving west, getting freer and more cornered in the same scenes.

An Arkansas waitress and a housewife shoot a rapist and take off in a '66 Thunderbird.

metas.name: The 400 Blows
metas.description:
Captures a boy being processed into a delinquent. Paris, a cramped flat, a teacher, small lies compounding into reform school — and a final run to the sea in one long take, ending on his face.

A young boy, left without attention, delves into a life of petty crime.

metas.name: The Night of the Hunter
metas.description:
Captures childhood danger as a fairy tale. A preacher with LOVE and HATE tattooed on his knuckles hunts two children down a river for hidden money; they flee by boat through a dreamlike, animal-watched night.

A self-proclaimed preacher marries a gullible widow whose young children are reluctant to tell him where their real dad hid the $10,000 he'd stolen in a robbery.

metas.name: Spotlight
metas.description:
Captures an investigation as a team slowly realising the size of the room they're in. Boston Globe reporters, church abuse, sealed records, survivors telling it plainly — no heroics beyond persistence.

The true story of how the Boston Globe uncovered the massive scandal of child molestation and cover-up within the local Catholic Archdiocese, shaking the entire Catholic Church to its core.

metas.name: Zodiac
metas.description:
Captures obsession with a case that will not close. San Francisco, years of codes, files, basements and false certainties; the killer fades and the men who chased him are what's left damaged.

Between 1968 and 1983, a San Francisco cartoonist becomes an amateur detective obsessed with tracking down the Zodiac Killer, an unidentified individual who terrorizes Northern California with a killing spree.

metas.name: Sicario
metas.description:
Captures an idealist being used as a legal fig leaf. An FBI agent attached to a border operation she is not briefed on, a convoy into Juárez filmed like an occupying army, rules revealed only after she has broken them.

An FBI agent joins a covert DoD task force targeting a Mexican cartel. Operating outside legal boundaries with a CIA handler and a mysterious fixer, she discovers the mission's true purpose goes far beyond what she was told.

metas.name: Close-Up
metas.description:
Captures a poor film fan who wanted, briefly, to be the man whose name he borrowed. In Tehran a man impersonates a famous director to a family, is arrested, and then everyone involved re-enacts their own case, including the trial.

The true story of Hossain Sabzian, a cinephile who impersonated the director Mohsen Makhmalbaf to convince a family they would star in his so-called new film.

metas.name: Funny Games
metas.description:
Captures the audience's appetite, by refusing to feed it the usual way. Two polite young men hold a family at their holiday house; violence happens off-screen or gets rewound, and the film keeps asking why you're still watching.

Two violent young men take a mother, father, and son hostage in their vacation cabin and force them to play sadistic "games" with one another for their own amusement.

metas.name: Rififi
metas.description:
Captures a robbery as manual labour. A Paris jewel heist whose centrepiece is roughly half an hour with no dialogue and no score — umbrellas, drills, plaster dust, men breathing — that every heist film since is quoting.

Four men plan a technically perfect crime, but the human element intervenes...

metas.name: The Killing
metas.description:
Captures a perfect plan told in pieces that don't line up in time. A racetrack robbery replayed from each participant's angle, a suitcase of money, and an airport finale involving a small dog.

Crook Johnny Clay assembles a five-man team to plan and execute a daring racetrack robbery.

metas.name: Sexy Beast
metas.description:
Captures menace arriving in a holiday villa. A retired gangster, happily fat and sunburned in Spain, and Ben Kingsley's Don Logan flying in to scream him back to London for one job — the terror is mostly conversational.

Brutal gangster Don Logan recruits "retired" safecracker Gal for one last job, but it goes badly for both of them.

metas.name: Inside Man
metas.description:
Captures a bank robbery as theatre with a purpose you have to wait for. Manhattan hostages dressed identically to the robbers, a detective and a fixer circling each other, and a heist whose real target isn't the money.

A police detective, a bank robber and a high-power broker enter high-stakes negotiations after the criminal's brilliant heist spirals into a hostage situation.

metas.name: Hell or High Water
metas.description:
Captures two brothers robbing the bank that is taking their family's land. West Texas, foreclosed ranches and debt-relief billboards, and two ageing Rangers following them at the speed of talk — a western wearing a recession.

A divorced father and his ex-con brother plan a series of heists against the bank that's about to foreclose on their family ranch.

metas.name: Timbuktu
metas.description:
Captures occupation resisted through music, football and dignity. Jihadists take a Malian town and ban singing and soccer; people comply in public, sing quietly at night, and play a match with an invisible ball.

A cattle herder and his family who reside in the dunes of Timbuktu find their quiet lives -- which are typically free of the Jihadists determined to control their faith -- abruptly disturbed.

metas.name: The Long Goodbye
metas.description:
Captures a decent man out of sync with his decade. Altman's Philip Marlowe shuffles through sunlit, corrupt Los Angeles in a rumpled suit, the last person still taking loyalty seriously.

Marlowe investigates a friend's alleged suicide, missing money and murder in 1970s Los Angeles.

metas.name: Decision to Leave
metas.description:
Captures desire conducted through surveillance. A detective falls for the widow of the man whose death he's investigating, watching her through binoculars and translation apps. Park Chan-wook's most restrained and most romantic film.

A detective investigating a man's death in the mountains meets the dead man's mysterious wife in the course of his dogged sleuthing.

metas.name: Anatomy of a Fall
metas.description:
Captures a marriage being reverse-engineered in a courtroom. A husband falls from a chalet roof; his wife's trial becomes an autopsy of their relationship, conducted through recordings, translations and a dog who may be the only witness.

A woman is suspected of murder after her husband's death; their half-blind son faces a moral dilemma as the main witness.

metas.name: The Thin Blue Line
metas.description:
Captures how 'eyewitness truth' is mostly people confidently describing things that never happened. Errol Morris reconstructs a policeman's murder through conflicting accounts and stylised re-enactments — and the film's evidence helped free the man convicted of it.

A film that successfully argued that a man was wrongly convicted for murder by a corrupt justice system in Dallas County, Texas.

metas.name: Capturing the Friedmans
metas.description:
Captures a family performing normality for a camera while everything underneath it collapses. A family accused of horrific crimes, told largely through their own compulsive home videos, which keep contradicting the legal case and each other.

Follows the Friedmans, a seemingly typical, upper-middle-class Jewish family whose world is instantly transformed when the father and his youngest son are arrested and charged with shocking and horrible crimes.

metas.name: Dear Zachary: A Letter to a Son About His Father
metas.description:
Captures grief and legal-system failure like nothing else here. It begins as a film for a baby about the father he'll never meet, murdered before he was born — then the case takes a turn mid-production that is almost unbearable.

A filmmaker decides to memorialize a murdered friend when his friend's ex-girlfriend announces she is expecting his son.

metas.name: Man on Wire
metas.description:
Captures pure, pointless, joyful daring — a crime with no victim and no motive except beauty. Philippe Petit's 1974 tightrope walk between the Twin Towers, told like a heist film by the crew who smuggled the rigging up.

A look at tightrope walker Philippe Petit's daring, but illegal, high-wire routine performed between New York City's World Trade Center's twin towers in 1974, what some consider, "the artistic crime of the century".

metas.name: The Imposter
metas.description:
Captures how badly people want a story to be true. A missing Texas teenager 'returns' three years later, older and with a French accent — and his family accepts him. The man himself explains exactly how he did it.

A documentary centered on a young man in Spain who claims to a grieving Texas family that he is their 16-year-old son who has been missing for 3 years.

metas.name: O.J.: Made in America
metas.description:
Captures a whole country's contradictions in one man's story. Nearly eight hours, and not really about a murder trial: Los Angeles, race, celebrity and policing across fifty years, with Simpson as the thread running through all of it.

A chronicle of the rise and fall of O.J. Simpson, whose high-profile murder trial exposed the extent of American racial tensions, revealing a fractured and divided nation.

metas.name: Collective
metas.description:
Captures corruption being dismantled in real time, and it plays like a thriller. After a Bucharest nightclub fire, burn victims start dying of infections in Romanian hospitals — and a sports newspaper, of all things, uncovers why.

Director Alexander Nanau follows a crack team of investigators at the Romanian newspaper Gazeta Sporturilor as they try to uncover a vast health-care fraud that enriched moguls and politicians and led to the deaths of innocent cit...

metas.name: Aileen: Life and Death of a Serial Killer
metas.description:
Captures the confrontational filmmaker finding his limit: Broomfield builds a real relationship with death-row killer Aileen Wuornos, testifies in her case, and films a final interview in which she is plainly no longer competent.

Nick Broomfield's second documentary about serial killer Aileen Wuornos, focusing on her mental state on death row.

metas.name: Tickled
metas.description:
Captures an investigation whose subject fights back in real time: journalist David Farrier asks a cheerful question about 'competitive endurance tickling' videos and receives legal threats so disproportionate that following them becomes the film.

Journalist David Farrier stumbles upon a mysterious tickling competition online. As he delves deeper he comes up against fierce resistance, but that doesn't stop him getting to the bottom of a story stranger than fiction.

metas.name: Strong Island
metas.description:
Captures grief conducted as cross-examination: Yance Ford investigates his brother's killing and the grand jury that declined to indict, addressing the camera directly and interrogating his own family's silence as hard as the legal system's.

When filmmaker Yance Ford investigates the 1992 murder of a young Black man, it becomes an achingly personal journey, since the victim, 24-year-old William Ford Jr., was the filmmaker's brother.

metas.name: Man Bites Dog
metas.director: Rémy Belvaux, André Bonzel, Benoît Poelvoorde
metas.description:
Captures the complicity problem pushed to its logical endpoint — the cluster's one fiction: a student crew follows a charming serial killer for a documentary, graduating from filming him, to holding the camera steady, to helping.

A film crew follows a ruthless thief and heartless killer as he goes about his daily routine. But complications set in when the film crew lose their objectivity and begin lending a hand.

metas.name: 13th
metas.description:
Captures the essay-documentary at maximum force — a thesis you can feel being assembled. DuVernay builds one chain from the Thirteenth Amendment's exception clause through convict leasing, Jim Crow and the war on drugs to mass incarceration.

An in-depth look at the prison system in the United States and how it reveals the nation's history of racial inequality.

metas.name: Inside Job
metas.description:
Captures elite impunity as a tone of voice. The 2008 financial crisis explained with unusual clarity and barely suppressed fury, including interviews where the architects keep incriminating themselves with total calm.

Takes a closer look at what brought about the 2008 financial meltdown.

metas.name: Paradise Lost: The Child Murders at Robin Hood Hills
metas.description:
Captures a Satanic-panic prosecution from the inside; the film itself became evidence in the decades-long fight over the case. Three Arkansas teenagers convicted of murder largely for liking Metallica and black clothes, filmed through the trial with access to every family.

A horrific triple child murder leads to an indictment and trial of three nonconformist boys based on questionable evidence.

metas.name: Tower
metas.description:
Captures how people inside an event remember it — partial, sensory, nothing like the news summary. The 1966 UT Austin sniper massacre retold in rotoscoped animation from survivors' memories, switching to real footage only at the end.

Animation, testimony, and archival footage combine to relate the events of August 1, 1966 when a gunman opened fire from the University of Texas clock tower, killing 16 people.

metas.name: Time of the Gypsies
metas.description:
Captures folk storytelling surviving, barely, inside modern crime. A Romani teenager with telekinetic powers is lured into a smuggling life in Italy, half narrated by Goran Bregović's score — Petrović's world taken into magical realism.

In this luminous tale set in the area around Sarajevo and in Italy, Perhan, an engaging young Romany (gypsy) with telekinetic powers, is seduced by the quick-cash world of petty crime, which threatens to destroy him and those he l...

metas.name: Black God, White Devil
metas.description:
Captures a peasant world where religion and violence are the only available languages. Rocha's Brazilian sertão — a hired killer, a self-proclaimed saint gathering followers, a blind bandit-prophet — is filmed like a folk ballad being sung at gunpoint, in glare and dust.

After killing his employer when he tries to cheat him out of his payment, a man becomes an outlaw and starts following a self-proclaimed saint.

metas.name: The Tribe
metas.description:
Captures a complete social world you must learn to read bodily or not at all. At a Ukrainian boarding school for deaf students, a student crime network runs everything — performed entirely in sign language, with no subtitles and no translation.

A deaf boy joins a boarding school for similar children. Confronted by the violent and criminal antics of some of the other boys and girls, he struggles to conform and join the 'tribe'.

metas.name: The Cremator
metas.description:
Captures evil as a smiling civil servant. A Prague crematorium director absorbs Nazi ideology as a career opportunity and a philosophy of hygiene, in Karel Höger's unbearably gentle monotone.

Set in Central Europe during World War II, a demented cremator believes cremation relieves earthly suffering and sets out to save the world.

metas.name: Benny's Video
metas.description:
Captures a murder committed to see how it looks on tape. A video-obsessed teenager films everything, including the act, and his parents' response is the coldest part. The complicit-camera theme, taken to its dead end.

A 14-year-old video enthusiast obsessed with violent films decides to make one of his own and show it to his parents, with tragic results.

metas.name: Snowtown
metas.description:
Captures radicalisation as a domestic process. In Adelaide's poorest suburbs, a charismatic man absorbs a vulnerable teenager into his "clean-up" campaign; true story, almost no on-screen violence, dread in every kitchen scene.

Based on true events, 16-year-old Jamie falls in with his mother's new boyfriend and his crowd of self-appointed neighborhood watchmen, a relationship that leads to a spree of torture and murder.

metas.name: An Elephant Sitting Still
metas.description:
Captures a single day with no exits in it. Four hours, one northern Chinese city, four people circling a rumoured elephant that just sits there; the director's only film, and the stillness is the point and the accusation.

Four people in a Chinese city live through a complicated day as their lives intersect.

metas.name: The Housemaid
metas.description:
Captures a home invaded by its own employee. A composer hires a maid; she takes the house apart floor by floor — piano lessons, rat poison, a staircase that becomes the film's moral geometry. Korean melodrama at fever pitch, restored from near-loss.

A composer and his wife are thrown into turmoil when a housemaid becomes more than they bargained for.

metas.name: A Touch of Sin
metas.description:
Captures a country where every humiliation eventually finds a weapon. Four true-crime stories from four provinces — a miner, a migrant, a sauna receptionist, a factory boy — woven until they feel like one long fuse.

Four independent stories set in modern China about random acts of violence.

metas.name: Save the Green Planet!
metas.description:
Captures a conspiracy theorist who might be right, played at full scream. A beekeeper kidnaps a chemicals CEO he believes is an alien prince; comedy, torture chamber, police procedural and apocalypse keep swapping places until the film lands somewhere genuinely sad.

Byeong-gu believes that the world is on the verge of an alien invasion, and sets out to save the world.

metas.name: Crimson Gold
metas.description:
Captures class humiliation at the pace of a pizza delivery. A Tehran courier, slighted in a jewellery store he could never shop in, returns with a gun; written by Kiarostami from a real case, and the city itself does most of the accusing.

An Iranian pizza delivery man sees the worst of corruption and social unbalance in his city and is driven to crime.

metas.name: Ghost in the Shell
metas.description:
Captures a cyborg major hunting a hacker who may be the first digital life-form, in long rain-slick silences between the action. The gap in your collection: the film that made "what counts as a self when every layer is replaceable" into mainstream science fiction, and it argues by canal boat and museum tree as much as by dialogue.

A cyborg policewoman and her partner hunt a mysterious and powerful hacker called the Puppet Master.
